core.brainwave_role: map real JANUS state into musical control signals
core.helios_role: turn those controls into coherent procedural musical phrases

inputs: Blind Eye / audio-node derived activity where available
M2R state and forecast confidence as control signals only

musical_mapping.density: bounded by swarm activity and event rate
musical_mapping.harmony: stable modes under low disagreement; controlled tension under higher disagreement
musical_mapping.accent: rare/anomalous transitions when audio is enabled
musical_mapping.motif_memory: reuse/transform previously learned phrases without treating them as evidence

mode_interaction.Q14_absolute_mute: ENTER mute overrides all musical/audio output without exception
mode_interaction.house_112269: retain amber visual identity; music may become fuller/denser but remains bounded and safe
mode_interaction.m2r_1488: may influence temporal motifs/forecast sonification while active; does not make music evidentiary
mode_interaction.anomaly: may alter musical state only if audio is enabled; LED/UI/Witness remain primary truth-preserving alert paths

truth_guard: musical consonance is not proof of correctness
musical dissonance is not proof of danger
sensor truth remains separate from sonification
